create_FuyuConfig: create a Fuyu model configuration with default or custom hyperparameters
build_FuyuConfig_text_config: build a FuyuConfig instance with a custom text_config dictionary or PreTrainedConfig object
configure_FuyuConfig_parameters: configure FuyuConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention_heads
initialize_FuyuConfig_defaults: initialize FuyuConfig with default values for image_size, patch_size, and num_channels
inspect_FuyuConfig_attributes: inspect FuyuConfig attributes like model_type, vocab_size, and rope_parameters
